<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="WtcfMpG4J27W-jg_n9vI"> <mxGraphModel dx="690" dy="409" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" background="light-dark(#FFFFFF,#121212)" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
title SecPipe Prototype 1 - Main Analysis Sequence

autoactivate on

actor User

participant \"SecPipe CLI\" as CLI
participant \"GraphRunner\" as Engine

participant \"SetupNode\" as Setup
participant \"ReconNode\" as Recon
participant \"ArchitectureSummaryNode\" as ReconSummary
participant \"DetectNode\" as Detect
participant \"AnalyzerAdapters\" as Adapters
participant \"NormalizeNode\" as Normalize
participant \"HuntWaveNode\" as Hunter
participant \"CriticNode\" as Critic
participant \"NormalizeNode\n(re-entry)\" as NormalizeLLM
participant \"DeterministicRefuterNode\" as Refuter
participant \"DisproverNode\" as Disprover
participant \"TestEvidenceNode\" as Evidence
participant \"ScoringNode\" as Scoring
participant \"RemediationLoopNode\" as Remediate
participant \"RecordVerifierNode\" as Verifier
participant \"FinalizeNode\" as Finalize
participant \"ReportNode\" as Report

User -> CLI: Run scan command
CLI -> Engine: run(initialState, ctx)

Engine -> Setup: apply(state, ctx)
Setup --> Engine: Result(next, delta)

Engine -> Recon: apply(updatedState, ctx)
Recon --> Engine: Result(next, delta)

Engine -> ReconSummary: apply(updatedState, ctx)
ReconSummary --> Engine: Result(next, delta)

Engine -> Detect: apply(updatedState, ctx)
Detect -> Adapters: Execute available analyzers
Adapters --> Detect: Candidates and coverage claims
Detect --> Engine: Result(next, delta)

Engine -> Normalize: apply(updatedState, ctx)
Normalize --> Engine: Result(next, delta)

loop Hunter/Critic coverage loop
 Engine -> Hunter: apply(updatedState, ctx)
 Hunter --> Engine: Result(NEXT or DONE, delta)

 alt Hunt returns DONE
 note over Engine
 Route directly to normalize_llm
 end note
 else Hunt returns NEXT
 Engine -> Critic: apply(updatedState, ctx)
 Critic --> Engine: Result(LOOP or DONE, delta)

 alt Critic returns LOOP
 note over Engine
 Route back to hunt (TRANSITIONS[\"critic\"][\"loop\"])
 end note
 else Critic returns DONE
 note over Engine
 Continue to normalize_llm (TRANSITIONS[\"critic\"][\"done\"])
 end note
 end
 end
end

Engine -> NormalizeLLM: apply(updatedState, ctx)
NormalizeLLM --> Engine: Result(next, delta)

Engine -> Refuter: apply(updatedState, ctx)
Refuter --> Engine: Result(next, delta)

Engine -> Disprover: apply(updatedState, ctx)
Disprover --> Engine: Result(next, delta)

Engine -> Evidence: apply(updatedState, ctx)
Evidence --> Engine: Result(next, delta)

Engine -> Scoring: apply(updatedState, ctx)
Scoring --> Engine: Result(next, delta)

Engine -> Remediate: apply(updatedState, ctx)
Remediate --> Engine: Result(next, delta)

Engine -> Verifier: apply(updatedState, ctx)
Verifier --> Engine: Result(next, delta)

Engine -> Finalize: apply(updatedState, ctx)
Finalize --> Engine: Result(next, delta)

Engine -> Report: apply(updatedState, ctx)
Report --> Engine: Result(next, delta)

Engine --> CLI: Return final PipelineState
CLI --> User: Display results and report location

@enduml",
 "config": null
